g.text: the backlog: where the task files live, what they carry, how the page shows them
How the tasks page shows them: table is a list with everything at a glance, board a kanban of columns.
v switches it on the page for the session; `list` and `kanban` work as names too. One of: table ·
What tasks are grouped by — the board's columns, the table's headings. One of: status · labels ·
Show a heading per group in the table (off = one flat list). G switches it on the page.
Hide finished tasks (done, cancelled) on the tasks page; h shows them for this session.
Command that opens a task file when you press enter on the tasks page (idea, code, vim, ...).
Folder (relative to the project) where task files T-001.md live; commit it to share the backlog.
Commit the task files with the project, so the backlog is shared (off = a .gitignore keeps them
Minimum length of a task's problem description.
A task must say how to check it before it is accepted.
